name: agrimarket_generate_otp
description: Sends OTP for Agri Marketing authentication. Does NOT verify OTP. Fails if Aadhaar invalid or mobile not registered.

name: agrimarket_verify_otp
description: Verifies OTP and returns session_token. Does NOT create listings or orders. Fails if OTP expired or incorrect.

name: agrimarket_create_listing
description: Creates a new crop listing for sale. Listing can be fixed_price or auction-based. Requires session_token. Only sellers can create. Does NOT place orders. Fails if commodity is unsupported, duplicate listing exists, or required fields missing.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all transactional tools.

name: agrimarket_search_listings
description: Searches available crop listings by commodity, location, quality, and price range. Requires session_token. Does NOT place orders. Fails if no listings match. Returns only 'active' listings.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all transactional tools.

name: agrimarket_get_listing_details
description: Retrieves full details of a specific listing including seller info, quantity, price, and status. Requires session_token. Does NOT modify listing. Fails if listing_id is invalid or listing is deleted.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all transactional tools.

listing_id.description: Unique identifier of a crop listing.

name: agrimarket_update_listing
description: Updates an existing listing (price, quantity, status). Only the creator can modify. Requires session_token. Does NOT create new listings. Fails if listing_id is invalid, user is not owner, or listing is deleted.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all transactional tools.

name: agrimarket_place_order
description: Places an order on an active listing. Transitions order_status to 'created'. Requires session_token. Listing must be active with sufficient quantity. Does NOT process payment. Fails if listing is inactive, insufficient quantity, or buyer places order on own listing. Orders cannot exceed available quantity.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all transactional tools.

name: agrimarket_track_order
description: Tracks order status ('created', 'confirmed', 'dispatched', 'delivered', 'completed', 'cancelled'). Requires session_token. Does NOT modify order. Fails if order_id is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all transactional tools.

name: agrimarket_track_payment
description: Tracks payment status ('pending', 'paid', 'failed', 'refunded') for an order. Payment must be successful before completion. Requires session_token. Does NOT process payments. Fails if order_id is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all transactional tools.

name: agrimarket_bid_on_listing
description: Places a bid on an auction-type listing. Requires session_token. Listing must be of type 'auction' with auction_status 'open' or 'bidding'. Does NOT guarantee winning. Fails if listing is not auction type, bid is below minimum price, or auction is closed.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all transactional tools.

bid_amount.description: Bid amount per unit in INR.

name: agrimarket_cancel_order
description: Cancels an existing order. Transitions order_status to 'cancelled'. Orders CANNOT be cancelled after dispatch. Requires session_token. Does NOT process refunds automatically. Fails if order is already dispatched, delivered, or completed.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all transactional tools.

name: agrimarket_track_delivery
description: Tracks delivery status for dispatched orders. Delivery tracking exists only after dispatch. Requires session_token. Does NOT modify delivery. Fails if order is not yet dispatched.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all transactional tools.

name: agrimarket_raise_grievance
description: Raises a grievance. Valid categories: 'payment_issue', 'order_not_delivered', 'wrong_quality', 'price_mismatch', 'listing_issue'. Must check order/payment status first. Requires session_token. Fails if category is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all transactional tools.

name: agrimarket_track_grievance_status
description: Tracks grievance status. Requires session_token. Fails if grievance_id is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all transactional tools.
